title: Resume Site
summary: A personal resume website built with server-rendered pages.
description: A single-page resume website that renders my experience, education, and skills from structured data. Built to learn server-side rendering and static generation with Next.js.

title: Task Tracker
summary: A small task tracker with local persistence and filtering.
description: A task tracking app that supports creating, completing, and filtering tasks by status. State is persisted locally so tasks survive page reloads.

title: Demystifying the Linux Kernel: A Visual Guide to User Space and Hardware
summary: A friendly, diagram-driven explainer that walks developers through how applications, the GNU C Library, system calls, kernel subsystems, and hardware interact in Linux.
description: This project is a visual explainer that breaks down the Linux architecture shown in the attached diagram. It's written for developers who want a clear, friendly walkthrough of what happens behind the scenes when an application runs on Linux.
